reason_for_new_protocol: The v1 fit window was stopped after 280 terminal games when a genuine RL-wrapper action-limit censor occurred at seed6600070. That game's underlying Antiyoy Game was nonterminal. The branch-local response-transition targets do not use eventual roll-in game winners, so a censored roll-in can supply valid earlier branch targets if every hypothetical continuation is replayed exactly. The rejected v1 partial data and all v1 reserved downstream windows remain unused.
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, original rules and 2400-action roll-in limit, no fog or diplomacy
teacher_and_source: At every atomic action, native replanned three-turn search uses root256/top8/beam32/branch48/max24, opponent full-turn64 and root followup32. Opponent arms are the frozen routed-v6 checkpoint SHA68549a5af87e4d2d065a164e39bc515c2c1d48276f437494d757e25c3ef28867 and the same native teacher. No terminal oracle may be used online.
collection: Run all four teacher-root versus source/teacher-opponent games per independent map and both root seats through either true core terminal or the unchanged 2400-action wrapper limit. Record terminal, winner, truncated and adjudicated-winner fields separately; never convert a truncated game to a terminal win. At reached own-action indices0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256, retain all native top8 candidate traces, exact root/post-candidate, opponent-reply and root-followup component vectors, three branch terminal classes and exact continuation action indices. Native plan replay must assert full Game equality including hidden RNG. Independent Python fork replay may extend only the hypothetical fork's wrapper action limit to u32::MAX to verify native core search continuation, never the live roll-in game. Any illegal action, component mismatch or unverified branch fails collection. All reached branch-local records from a wrapper-censored roll-in remain in the fit/offline dataset, tagged with that game's censor status; none is selectively dropped or given a game-outcome label.
model_and_objective: Unchanged from v1: fixed initialization seed6600000; one 16-dimensional action-trace GRU hidden32; concatenate last real state with root and exact post-candidate 16-component vectors normalized by20 except money50, income/upkeep20 and province count5, plus static score/1000; one width32 ReLU layer; output opponent-reply and root-followup 16-component deltas and three terminal-class logits. Map-balanced Huber loss on both normalized deltas plus equal-weight cross-entropy, AdamW learning rate0.001, weight decay0.01, gradient clip1, exactly two epochs. No direct action, whole-plan log-probability or scalar-score fitting. At inference score the predicted followup components with the unchanged evaluator coefficient dot product plus fixed1000*(pwin-ploss), preserve exact already-terminal root candidates, break ties by static score then candidate index, execute only the first legal action and replan next atomic action.
resource_gate: Before fit, use all eight fresh calibration maps with the same four arms and reached action indices, timed random-model selector versus native teacher on identical live states. Record censored roll-in games but do not treat them as wins. Require all32 games attempted, every candidate root plan and component vector exact, median selector wall at most80% teacher, p95 no worse than teacher, and each seat median at most80% teacher. No architecture or threshold change after calibration.
offline_gate: On all64 fresh validation maps and four arms, require every reached branch exact and all256 games attempted with terminal/censor counts explicit; wrapper-censored roll-in games remain included in branch-local offline metrics. Require map-balanced normalized followup-component MAE at least10% below the fixed no-response post-candidate baseline, and teacher-selected candidate agreement versus static top candidate with independent-map two-sided exact sign p<0.05 and nonnegative gain in each seat. Any branch-integrity failure or offline metric failure rejects the checkpoint without opening game windows. No validation retuning.
game_gates: Only after offline pass, use fresh complete both-seat independent-map head-to-head games. Direct gate seed6613000 requires at least160/256 candidate terminal wins, at least65/128 per candidate seat, independent-map sign p<0.05 versus direct self-play on the same pool, zero timeout and zero wrapper censor. Teacher gate seed6614000 requires at least64/256 candidate terminal wins, at least28/128 per candidate seat, zero timeout and zero wrapper censor. A censored candidate game counts as a loss and also fails the zero-censor promotion gate. Report fixed-pool paired Elo and map-bootstrap95%, never global Elo.
promotion_gate: Only after both game gates, final disjoint seed6615000 repeats both opponent comparisons over256 independent maps/both seats with thresholds scaled to512 games and zero censor. Disjoint Generic, Online Default and Classic Slay runtime windows seed6616000/6617000/6618000 require candidate median CPU at most80% native replanned teacher and p95 candidate wall no worse, with explicit terminal/finite-horizon counts. Slay nonterminal games cannot establish terminal strength. Any Site release additionally requires browser WASM equivalence and latency, retains owner-only access and leaves rated bot unchanged.
stopping_and_integrity: No architecture, loss, hyperparameter, window, threshold or censor rule change after the first v2 calibration result. Any branch-integrity failure stops the current window. A fit or offline roll-in censor is recorded and retained, not silently dropped; a game-strength censor fails promotion. The v1 seed6600000 fit fragment, v1 calibration seed6601000, v1 reserved seeds6602000 through6608000, all earlier inspected/rejected student windows and legacy seed6300000 are excluded from v2 data and games.
